description: Special mechanics are kept in code/configurator for future iteration, but no level should currently ship with any special mechanic enabled.
reasons: Golden reward currently has click-blocking edge cases when stacked with other tiles.
Drop chutes and conveyors have tile icon scaling/stretching inconsistencies.
Piggies can remain after cover tiles are cleared in some layouts.
Some combined-mechanic levels can produce tiles that appear clickable but do not respond.
notes: All level-XXX.json files should omit the mechanics field while this policy is active.
Do not re-apply generated mechanic curves until the kept mechanics are QA-fixed and explicitly approved.
The three retained candidate mechanics are golden reward, right slot lock, and crow snatch, but they are not assigned to any level now.
